title: File record
description: Record of a file in the farm file store: bytes plus a record that only the core writes (ART-1). Fields per docs/capabilities.md, section "Files and artifacts"; lifecycle spec/lifecycles/file.md. The file content is always untrusted for the model (ART-2). The sha256 of the content lives only inside the core and is not part of the record that is handed out.

origin.description: upload: a principal uploaded it in a chat; produced: an attempt or a toolhost created it; ingested: a job task brought it.

producer.description: Producer: a task or a principal.

media_type.description: Content type that the core determined from the bytes.

untrusted.description: The file content is untrusted for the model in any state (ART-2).

personal_seen.description: Whether the content saw personal data and how this is known; only the core sets it and never clears it (AUD-5, ART-6).

state.description: State from spec/lifecycles/file.md; expired since v0.2.
